benchmark_entry.name: Smile no-arbitrage: Roper's theorem, the left wing, calendar spreads, one Black form
benchmark_entry.description: For any everywhere-positive total variance `w`, the Black form `blackForm k (w k)` tends to 0 at large `k` exactly when `d₊(k, w k)` tends to `-∞`.

code.lean:
import MathFin.Models.ModelFree.BlackFormTail

open MathFin
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

/-- For any everywhere-positive total variance `w`, the Black form `blackForm k (w k)` tends to 0 at large `k` exactly when `d₊(k, w k)` tends to `-∞`. -/
theorem mf_smile_black_form_tail_iff (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun k ↦ MathFin.ForwardSmile.blackForm k (w k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ↔
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k ↦ MathFin.ForwardSmile.dpl k (w k)) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot :=
  MathFin.blackForm_tendsto_zero_iff_dpl_tendsto_atBot w hw
